risks.claim: Frontline faces earnings volatility from tanker-market cyclicality because 77 of its 80 vessels operated in the voyage charter or short-term market, global oil consumption fell 2.4 mbpd year-on-year, and ballast days are expected to reduce fourth-quarter spot TCEs.
quotes: Historically, the tanker industry has been highly cyclical, with volatility in profitability, charter rates and asset values resulting from changes in the supply of, and demand for, tanker capacity and changes in the supply of and demand for oil and oil products.
As of December 31, 2025, 77 of our 80 vessels were employed in the voyage charter market or on short-term or variable rate time charters.
We expect the spot TCEs for the full fourth quarter of 2026 to be lower than the spot TCEs currently contracted, due to the impact of ballast days during the fourth quarter of 2026.
